sources.title: GitHub - krishikasahni/SafeScrollAI: An AI-Based Violence Detection ...
sources.snippet: SafeScrollAI is a deep learning-based web application that automatically detects violent content in uploaded videos. The system analyzes video frames and classifies videos into different risk categories while providing confidence scores, AI recommendations, visual analytics, downloadable reports, and detection history.
